dynamic_headers_by_gang_month_optimized.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.DocDesc FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND t.DocDesc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.DocDesc

dynamic_headers_by_gang_month_with_amoun.sql: SELECT t.DocDesc, SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) AS TotalAmount FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? GROUP BY t.DocDesc HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC
